text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower and I are on the way back
to campus
after going out, when...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, Big Brother?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, Big Sister?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I don't want to say goodbye just yet...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I don't want to say goodbye just yet...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Actually, there's something I want to go
see with
you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her expression is so sincere I can't say
no.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We head up to the academy rooftop to
wait for
the sun to set.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
There's supposed to be a meteor shower
today.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
As soon as I heard about it, I knew I had
to watch
it with you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
As soon as I heard about it, I knew I had
to watch
it with you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thank you for coming.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thank you for coming.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: There sure are a lot of clouds, huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sure enough, the sky is full of clouds
everywhere I
look, forming an opaque
wall over most of the
sky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm a bit worried that she might blame
the state of
the sky on herself, but..

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: H-hey, Big Brother?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: H-hey, Big Sister?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Will you wait with me just a bit longer?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Just until the clouds clear up... Until we
can see
the sky.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Is that okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look at Rice Shower and realize my
concern was
unfounded.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look at Rice Shower and realize my

unfounded.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Did I say something weird?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, y-yeah. A while ago... I probably
wouldn't
have been able to say that.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The old me probably would have started
crying...
But I'm not like that anymore.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I decided that I wanted to see shooting
stars with
you today...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I decided that I wanted to see shooting
stars with
you today...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: And I won't give up until that happens.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah! Look! Look at the sky!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah! Look! Look at the sky!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The clouds have already disappeared,
revealing a
night sky full of twinkling
stars.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Among the inviting flood of gleaming
points, a
sudden streak of light
plummets down. Then
another, and
another.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wooow! There are so many shooting
stars!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Definitely!
choice_data_list: It was worth the wait, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is sure to be an unforgettable night
for us.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad you're staying.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad you're staying.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...What are you going to wish for?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...What are you going to wish for?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! For me?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I didn't expect that, but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: It's similar to my wish.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
My wish... is for the happiness of
everyone who
supports me...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Including yours.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Including yours.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, a glitter catches the corner of
my eye.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Look! The sky...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Look! The sky...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unbeknownst to us, the sky cleared up
during our
chat. When we look up, we
see an ocean of stars.
And one falls out
of the sky, then another... and
then a
shower of them.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wooow! There are so many shooting
stars!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Right!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower and I both wish upon the
rain of
falling stars.
